combined.note: Distinct files across the two focused runs; not a full-suite run.

changes: Text and vision configurations carry confirmed-read readiness and errors in the existing context state/ref, without a second configuration cache. Per-role reloads have a 15-second request deadline, cancel superseded reads, and ignore old-account/old-revision responses.

Failed or malformed reads remain visible and retryable. Saves are refused until the authenticated current account has a confirmed configuration. Read and write confirmations share required-field/model-map/routing/migration metadata validation.

Own successful writes publish the existing configuration event with an app-context origin marker, avoiding a duplicate self-reload that could overwrite its just-confirmed model. External configuration events still reload both roles.
Reasoning, vision and provider pages reuse the existing loading/error/retry component. An inherited world model cannot be tested before vision preferences load; first-run setup exposes retry too.
Tests cover independent role errors/retries, malformed confirmations, deadlines, stale reads, logout, new-account loading gates, settings entry controls, inherited vision and setup retry.
limitations: Configuration readiness guards settings updates and tests, not a new global chat/execution availability gate. Previously confirmed values remain in memory during a failed refresh; they are hidden from the guarded settings controls.
A request cancellation cannot undo a server write already accepted. No automatic write retries or multi-client transaction lock were added.
No full-suite run, native-client/visual/live-model acceptance, backend rebuild, actual user data modification, commit, push or client restart.

The two previously reported gaps are addressed in code and focused tests; this does not mark the entire project audit or simplification complete. These correctness fixes add source/test lines rather than reduce total size.
